subject: Mentor??
author: Jinno Angelo
body:
Mentor?? I have no time to mentor anyone. I dont think I have ever taken the time to teach anyone anything about Burnout.. I'll be happy to give out tips but actually carrying someone to make them better at BO is harder and time consuming. I would do it if the person lives near me and we'd meet up and play some Revenge you know but over XBL is a different story. I think youd probably have to show some people how to do it, not just explain what to do you know?

 

As for Mark being here? Is he not a Revenge junkie? I mean after all he does play Revenge and wants people to help him with his rank.... But hey what exactly is a criteria for a person to be an Aholic?? Me, personally I just want to see him race and see if what I heard is true. If thats the case, then I'll tell him that "You earn your rank when you race me." Plain and simple...

 

 

------------------------------------------------

"Take the light, undarken everything around me." "Call the clouds and listen closely I'm lost without you." "Call your name every day when I feel so helpless." "I've fallen down but I'll rise above this, rise above this."

subject: GamerTag answers
author: ZombieTron
body:
The gamertag to add is:

BurnoutAholics

Although it is only a silver account, once you are on the friends list you can see what the other people on the friends list are doing, send them messages and game invites etc.

Silver accounts can't play online, but most of the people on the friends list have gold accounts.

This may be made into a Gold Account for special events in the future. Watch this space.... 🎮
